		debug_log = "PMR_DAM|start|147 projects|-|[TimeKeeper.GetCurrentDate.GetString]"

		}

}

on_yearly_pulse_country = {
	on_actions = { pmr_dam_yearly }
}

pmr_dam_yearly = {
	effect = {
		if = {
			limit = { has_technology_researched = electrical_generation }
			debug_log = "PMR_DAM|bur_year|-|[THIS.GetCountry.GetNameNoFormatting]|[TimeKeeper.GetCurrentDate.GetString]|bur [THIS.GetCountry.MakeScope.ScriptValue('pmr_dam_bur_produced')|0]/[THIS.GetCountry.MakeScope.ScriptValue('pmr_dam_bur_used')|0]|surveys [THIS.GetCountry.MakeScope.ScriptValue('pmr_dam_active')|0] building [THIS.GetCountry.MakeScope.ScriptValue('pmr_dam_building_now')|0]"
			if = {
				limit = { is_construction_paused = yes }
				debug_log = "PMR_DAM|gov_paused|-|[THIS.GetCountry.GetNameNoFormatting]|[TimeKeeper.GetCurrentDate.GetString]"
			}
			if = {
				limit = { construction_queue_government_duration >= 520 }
				debug_log = "PMR_DAM|gov_backlog|-|[THIS.GetCountry.GetNameNoFormatting]|[TimeKeeper.GetCurrentDate.GetString]|over 520 weeks"
			}
		}
	}
}

pmr_dam_driver = {
	effect = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				is_player = no

				is_at_war = no
				in_default = no
				scaled_debt < 0.5
				OR = {
					is_subject = no
					AND = { scaled_debt < 0.1  net_fixed_income > 0 }
				}
			}
			set_variable = { name = pmr_dam_driver_cd days = 90 }
			if = {
				limit = { pmr_dam_survey_headroom > 0 }
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_technology_researched = steam_turbine
						NOT = { has_variable = pmr_dam_columbia_river_surveyed }
						NOT = { has_global_variable = pmr_dam_columbia_river_surveying }
						NOT = { has_global_variable = pmr_dam_columbia_river_claim }
						NOT = { p:x3F0EE7.state ?= { any_scope_building = { is_building_type = building_dam_columbia_river  level_after_queued_constructions >= 19 } } }
						p:x3F0EE7 ?= {
							state ?= {
								owner ?= {
									OR = {
										this = ROOT
										any_overlord_or_above = { this = ROOT }
									}
								}
							}

							NOT = { p:x3F0EE7 ?= { state ?= { owner ?= ROOT } } }

							NOT = { p:x3F0EE7 ?= { state ?= { owner ?= ROOT } } }
